bye_overval_fade_stacked_on_production.classification_evidence: Week-blocked 95% CI [-0.4670, +1.6880] accuracy points, P+ 0.8474 (n=1503 games, 107 week-blocks); season-blocked secondary 95% CI [+0.1266, +1.4175], P+ 0.9980 (6 season-blocks). Point estimate is POSITIVE on both blockings; the week-blocked interval crosses zero and the season-blocked interval sits entirely ABOVE zero, so wrong_sign_resolved (which requires the WHOLE interval below zero on BOTH blockings) does not apply; no positive control was run against this stacked form, so positive_control_bound does not apply either. Per AGENTS.md an interval crossing zero is never grounds to close a line of work -- this is a mined-seasons read (already-looked-at 2020-2025 opener archive) offered as CONTEXT for the registration decision, not a gate; the underlying registry cell bye_overval_fade_full_slate_post2011 (week-blocked P+ 0.8375, n=2171, seasons 2012-2025) is the primary evidence.
bye_overval_fade_stacked_on_production.description: bye_edge_fade_overlay (fade the strict, >=12-day-gap bye-holding side wherever exactly one team is off a strict bye and the model's own pick sits on that side) stacked on top of the active model's own opener-graded PRODUCTION picks, REG 2020-2025, 1503 scored games, 68 games flipped.
bye_overval_fade_stacked_on_production.notes: Stacked-on-production read for the bye_edge_fade_overlay prospective challenger (scripts/bye_edge_fade_stacked_backtest.py; docs/bye_edge_fade_overlay.md). n_flipped=68 of 1537 games. Baseline is the active model's own opener-graded production card (artifacts/opener_evaluation/20260819T174244Z/per_game.parquet), not a synthetic baseline.
bye_overval_fade_stacked_on_production.plain_summary: Teams coming off a real bye often get overrated by the market; this fades them, flipping the pick away from the rested team whenever the model's own pick was already on that side. Layered on top of what the model actually plays across 1,503 graded games (2020-2025), it flips 68 games and nudges accuracy from 53.36% to about 53.96% -- a small move that is mostly favorable: the week-by-week read still crosses zero, but the season-by-season read is fully positive.
